name: Generate an SEO content brief
prompt: Create an SEO content brief for our new blog post about 'machine learning in education'.
expected_behavior: Reads .agents/<productname>/product.md for product and audience context
Identifies the search intent and target persona
Provides title and meta description recommendations
Creates a structured outline with H2 and H3 tags
Lists primary, secondary, and semantic keywords to include

name: Update brief based on competitor gap
prompt: Update the brief to cover gaps found in competitor content.
expected_behavior: Adds new H2s/H3s to the outline to cover missing information
Ensures the brief is comprehensive and authoritative
